title: Editor throws error `Condition "p_column > text[p_line].length()" is true. Returning: 0` when typing a comment with chinese input
body:
Bugsquad edit: Removed the chinese description as only makes harder to read and small adjusts to keep more clean. ### Tested versions I **only** tested version **4.5.1.stable**

I discovered an interesting issue: when this comment is empty, the input will produce an error; but if this comment already contains Chinese content, it does not occur (see 'Reproduction Steps'). Moreover, after entering a certain amount of content, this error no longer occurs. (Sometimes)
### Steps to reproduce 1. Use a Chinese input method 2. Create a new .gd script 3. Type # and then enter Chinese content after it For details, please refer to the video (If the issue cannot be reproduced in the MRP, please try creating a new script file) https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/47fed91e-25be-42b1-b168-e48d2a5810b0
### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) Yes, it only takes one script to reproduce. [test_project.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24838042/test_project.zip)
